title: Keto Crispy Bacon Oozing Bites
description: A keto twist on classic oozing bites, crispy bacon adds a smoky flavor to these bite-sized treats.

ingredients.name: Spicy sauce (like sriracha or hot sauce)

instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Cut the bacon in half and wrap each piece around a small ball of oozing cheese.
3. Place the bacon-wrapped cheese on the prepared baking sheet.
4. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the bacon is crispy and golden brown.
5. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped chives or scallions if desired.
6. Drizzle with spicy sauce if desired.
